# Zahir Islam

He runs SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile, AI search optimization (GEO/AEO), Google Ads and Meta Ads for e-commerce, lead-generation and local businesses in Bangladesh, the UK, the UAE and Turkey. 31+ client brands. The results below come from the clients' own Google Search Console, Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager and Google Business Profile reports.

## Services

- [Local SEO](https://zahirislam.com/service-local-seo.html): Local SEO that turns nearby searches into calls, visits and bookings. Google Maps rankings, citations, reviews and reporting by Zahir Islam.
- [Google Business Profile Management](https://zahirislam.com/service-google-business-profile.html): Google Business Profile management that gets you found on Google Maps and brings more calls, like 4,632 calls for one Dubai restaurant.
- [AI Search Optimization](https://zahirislam.com/service-ai-search.html): Get your business recommended and cited by ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews. AI search optimization (GEO and AEO) by Zahir Islam.
- [Google Ads Management](https://zahirislam.com/service-google-ads.html): Google Ads campaigns built around cost per customer, not clicks. Fully tracked, with plain-language monthly reports. Search, Performance Max and Demand Gen.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://zahirislam.com/service-meta-ads.html): Facebook and Instagram ads that bring leads, calls and sales. Lead forms, messaging and call ads, e.g. 17,458 leads at $2.27 each for a property company.
- [White Label SEO](https://zahirislam.com/service-white-label-seo.html): White label SEO, Google Business Profile, Google Ads and Meta Ads for agencies. I deliver the work behind the scenes; your client only sees your brand.
- [CRM and AI Automation](https://zahirislam.com/service-crm-ai-automation.html): CRM and AI automation that captures every lead, replies instantly, books appointments and follows up for you, so no enquiry from ads or your website goes cold.

## Frequently asked questions

### Who is Zahir Islam?
Zahir Islam (Md Zahirul Islam) is a digital marketing manager and digital marketing lead based in Dhaka, Bangladesh; this site is his digital marketer portfolio. He runs SEO, local SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads for e-commerce, lead-generation and local businesses, and has worked with 31+ client brands in Bangladesh, the UK, the UAE and Turkey.

### What digital marketing services does Zahir Islam offer?
Local SEO, Google Business Profile management, AI search optimization (GEO and AEO), Google Ads management, Meta Ads management, white label SEO for agencies, and CRM and AI automation. You can hire him for one channel or a full growth plan.

### What results has Zahir Islam delivered for clients?
Examples include 96,200 Google clicks in six months for Fitnessmart.com.bd, 17,458 Meta Ads leads at $2.27 each for Dreamway Holdings, 4,632 phone calls from Google for a Dubai restaurant, and 62 parent enquiries in five weeks for a London tuition centre.

### Can Zahir Islam work as our digital marketing manager?
Yes. Many clients hire him as an outsourced digital marketing manager or digital marketing lead. He sets the strategy and budget, runs SEO, Google Ads and Meta Ads, and reports with a weekly dashboard and a monthly call, so you get a senior marketer without building an in-house team.

### Does Zahir Islam work with businesses outside Bangladesh?
Yes. Alongside Bangladeshi brands, he has run campaigns for a tuition centre in London, a restaurant in Dubai and a property company in Turkey.

### How do I start working with Zahir Islam?
Send your details through the contact form or WhatsApp (+880 1644-842785). You get a free audit with three quick wins within 48 hours, then a 90-day plan with channels, budget and target numbers.
